dct_title_s: Pacific Coast : San Diego to Point St. George California
dct_description_sm: Published at Washington D.C. June 1914 by the U.S. Coast and Geodetic Survey ; O.H. Tittmann, Superintendent.
Depths shown by soundings, relief (at peaks) by hachures and spot heights.
Tides table, magnetic variation compass roses (for 1915).
Shows low water areas, islands, ports, lights (and their range), cities, rocks, wrecks.
